gameDescriptionHtml:
Make your gold mining dream come true – start with a few spare bucks and work your way up to becoming a millionaire! The Gold Mining Simulator game is based on real-world mining techniques and machines.

Game Features

  • Mining Equipment – Sit behind the wheel of multiple vehicles such as excavator, drill, front-end loader, bulldozer, and others. The whole gold mining operation depends on your steering skills!
  • Failures & Repairs – Experience the challenging life of a chief mechanic. Various parts of machines can break when least expected and cost you big time.
  • Realistic Mining Process – Keep improving your gold mining business. Start with a simple bucket and a hog pan, lease your first claim, and upgrade it to next tiers, as you begin to dig gold.
  • Highly Detailed Machines – Admire highly detailed vehicles and gold mining machines. Purchase new and more efficient wash plant parts to increase your earnings.
  • 4 Unique Claims – We created a big, detailed world with four unique gold mining claims. On each, you will find a fully deformable terrain. Each fragment of our world has its own background story you can discover in your spare time.
  • (DLC) Find new resources! – Diamonds Creek claim grounds are full of precious gems that you can find in your gold pan and washplants. Sell the gems for some extra cash to upgrade your setup or spend them on cool skins in the paint shop! Don’t forget to install the new Gems traps in your Tier 3, otherwise the water will wash them all out!
  • (DLC) Discover new digging spots! – The new claim is full of beautiful places to explore and hidden secrets. Landslides, marshlands and open-pit mines, and you might even stumble upon abandoned cave mines!
  • (DLC) Face new challenges! – Clean the obstacles using machines and cables or speed it up with explosions. Manage the flooding water that can easily damage your equipment if you turn the pumps off for too long. Rebuild broken bridges to unlock rich digging spots or fight the overwhelming darkness deep in the mines.
  • (DLC) Operate the new backhoe loader – Take control of a versatile backhoe loader to dig, transport, and shape terrain with precision. Perfect for loading material and speeding up your mining operations early on.
  • (DLC) Alternative game start – Thanks to its progressive development, this map offers many hours of gameplay, providing a great new starting point all the way through to mid-game. It will appeal to both new players and veteran miners.
  • (DLC) Unravel hidden secrets – Valuable equipment like abandoned mining gear, dynamite and tools are hiding around the corners. Don’t forget about the powerstation! Once you restore the connection and fuel the supply tank it will provide electicity to every power pole on the parcels!

Included DLCs:

  • Collector’s Edition Upgrade
  • Frankenstein Machinery
  • Mini Mining Machines
  • Orange Beast
  • Gems & Glory
